description: requests.get() is called with verify=False, disabling TLS certificate validation for all outbound HTTPS requests. Combined with the SSRF vulnerability, this means an attacker can direct the server to fetch HTTPS URLs from attacker-controlled infrastructure without certificate validation, enabling MITM interception of the fetched content.
exploitation_scenario: Set up an HTTPS server with a self-signed cert at attacker.com. POST /api/rfivuln with {"imagelink": "https://internal-service/secret-token"}. Position MITM between server and internal-service. Since verify=False, the MITM certificate is accepted and the secret is intercepted.
suggested_fix: Remove verify=False. Use verify=True (the default). If custom CA certs are needed, use verify='/path/to/ca-bundle.crt'.
